question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e**. 'Agendas'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct option** to fill in the blank number 1 is ** "agendas".**
 
• The word** "agendas" **refers to underlying intentions or motives of individuals or groups.
 
• **In the context **of this sentence, it fits perfectly as it is referring to the intentions of social media platforms and people using them, who often have the motive of selling something.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *Social media platforms and many people on them have their own **agendas** and they are often trying to sell you things. So, be (2) ______ of how much time and energy you give to sellers and users and think about (3) ______ they want from you when engaging. To gauge which uses are positive and (4) ______ and which are detrimental, ask yourself simply, when does using social media make me feel good or bad, and why? Do I (5) ______use it all of the time?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at why the other options are not correct:
 
 
• **"Steam"** - This word generally refers to the vapor into which water is converted when heated, or to energy or power. Neither of these meanings fit well in this context.
 
• **"Excuses"** - While people on social media may indeed offer excuses, this word would not make sense in the context of this sentence, which is more about underlying motives than about justifying or excusing actions.
 
• **"Considerations" **- While social media platforms and users might indeed have considerations, this word doesn't quite convey the underlying motives or intentions implied by the sentence.
